watches.name: Circuit Chronograph: Limited Anniversary Edition
watches.description: DESCRIPTION Hand assembled here in Austin, TX, the Circuit take its inspiration from the world famous Circuit of the Americas road course just outside Austin. This legendary track plays host to one of the most spectacular events in sport- the F1 Grand Prix. Only 50 total pieces will ever be produced, available in two dial options. I designed several Easter Eggs into each watch, including a 130 mark on the tachymeter to denote the 130 foot elevation change at the track, the chapter ring has an 11 degree slope to match the highest bank angle on the course, and the track outline is engraved into each case back crystal. If you are a DuFrane and F1 fan, this is the watch for you! The Limited Anniversary Edition Circuit will deliver on the full titanium bracelet, as well as red curved end leather strap. The leather strap also includes a titanium buckle, with a DuFrane first micro-adjusting buckle ! Additionally, the buckle is engraved with the DuFrane logo, and filled with Swiss SuperLumiNova in the same color as the 10:00 marker on the dial. The 10 glows a different color that the rest of the dial, to denote the special 10 year anniversary. SPECIFICATIONS 1200 Vickers, DLC coated for scratch resistance 39mm case width 47mm lug to lug 13.5mm thick 20mm lug size Titanium grade 2 case, with all-new titanium reeded bezel 1.8oz (52g) with leather strap, 3.5oz on the bracelet (100g) 6.5mm screw down crown Sapphire crystal 5x anti-reflective coating Swiss SuperLumiNova BGW9 numerals and handset Open sapphire case back Swiss made ETA 7753 top grade full decoration anodized black skeletonized rotor with rose gold accents automatic mechanical chronograph (4Hz/28.8k bps) in-house regulated and timed to +/-4 secs per day 42-48 hour power reserve Includes Ti SEL bracelet and red curved leather strap 100m water resistance (use caution around water as pushers can allow water intrusion)

specsRaw.in-house: regulated and timed to +/-4 secs per day

watches.name: Westlake 36mm Manual Wind Dress Watch
watches.description: DESCRIPTION The Westlake is a study in quiet refinement—an elegant dress watch, where understated luxury defines everyday life. Designed to complement moments that call for effortless polish—whether it’s a mid morning brunch at Swedish Hill, a round of golf, a day out boating, or an evening overlooking Lake Austin —The Westlake embodies a balance of sophistication and ease. Its clean lines, restrained detailing, and timeless proportions reflect the architectural beauty and elevated lifestyle of its namesake, making it a natural companion for those who appreciate craftsmanship without excess. This is a watch that doesn’t demand attention, but earns it—just like Westlake itself. SPECIFICATIONS 800 Vickers , DLC coated for scratch resistance (Brunch Blue and Hill Country Wine only) 36mm case width 44mm lug to lug 6.99mm thick 18mm lug size 316L surgical stainless steel case 1.6oz (44g) with Cordovan leather strap, 2.5oz with mesh bracelet (80g) 5.5mm double gasket push/pull crown Sapphire crystal front and back with 5x anti-reflective coating on the front S wiss SuperLumiNova BGW9 on handset Includes both mesh bracelet and curved end Shell Cordovan leather strap 50m/5ATM water resistance Swiss Peseux 7001 elaboré grade in-house engraved ratchet wheel (Westlake model symbols) manual wind mechanical (3Hz/21.6k bps) in-house regulated and timed to +/-4 secs per day 42 hour power reserve

specsRaw.Every Westlake ships with two straps: a steel mesh bracelet and a curved end Shell Cordovan leather strap.

watches.name: Travis 39mm MkII Mechanical Diving Watch
watches.description: DESCRIPTION The Travis MkII takes all of its' design cues from the original Travis diver, but adds some incredible updates and changes. I certainly hope y'all will like them! Lake Travis (the Travis model namesake) is Austin's main water supply and reservoir. Check out below for a little more on Lake Travis history. Believe it or not, folks actually even SCUBA dive in parts of the lake. The Travis MkII now offers a date window with a color matched date disc, three new dial colors (including never before used orange called 40 Acres), freshly designed and finished chapter ring, five-link ultra SEL bracelet, more Swiss made SuperLumiNova lum on the dial and bezel insert, and a super high quality seatbelt nylon pass through secondary strap. The watch is still rated for 656 feet/200 meters of water resistance, and includes the finely polished chamfers on the case for some added detail. SPECIFICATIONS 39mm case width 47mm lug to lug 12mm height 20mm lug width 316L marine grade stainless steel DLC coated to 800 vickers 656ft/200m rated water resistance 6.5mm screw down, signed crown Screw down case back with Texas Star engraved Swiss Sellita automatic mechanical SW200-1 (elaborè grade) Regulated to +/- 4 seconds per day 38hr power reserve Incabloc shock system on the balance 20mm SEL bracelet tapers to 18mm “On the fly” adjustment bracelet, DLC coated to 800 vickers Sapphire/Aluminum bezel insert, 120 click uni-directional bezel Sapphire crystal with 5x anti-reflective coating under crystal X1 grade C3 SuperLumiNova lum: dial, hands and bezel insert Diamond cut, rhodium polished handset (40 Acres flat white framed) 5.8oz with bracelet (all links)

watches.name: Barton Springs- MkIV Pre-order
watches.description: DESCRIPTION Barton Springs is Austin's spring-fed swimming area. For thousands of years, the springs were used by the Tonkawa Native American tribe for purification rituals. Today, Barton Springs is one of Austin’s most visited local gems. In fact, Robert Redford learned to swim at Barton Springs when he was a child! The pool has a constant 68 degree temperature year around- perfect for the soaring Texas summers. In 1837, William (Uncle Billy) Barton settled the area and took to naming the three springs that feed the pool after his three daughters (Parthenia, Eliza, and Zenobia). In the 1920’s, the area was deeded to the city of Austin, and it was then the pool took the formation it has today with concrete walls and sidewalks. Incorporating the D|System features, the Barton Springs includes D|Change , D|Adjust and D|Protect . Each piece will deliver on an all-new 3-Link SEL bracelet, and a full lume FKM Tropical Rubber strap. It is highly recommended to dap a tiny drop of Loctite Purple 222 to each screw pin when sizing the bracelet to prevent pins from unseating.I provide this service when the optional bracelet sizing is selected. SPECIFICATIONS Marine grade 316L stainless steel Sapphire open case back 42mm width (case and bezel) 47.4mm lug-to-lug 11.9mm height 316L solid end link 3-Link bracelet, and FKM rubber strap (included) 22mm lug width Case weight 84g Case weight w/bracelet 118g 7mm screw down crown, 2X silicone gasket system Water resistance 20ATM (656ft/200m) Five layer (inside) anti-reflective coating 120 click uni-directional timing bezel Swiss SuperLumiNova C3 X1 grade lume Aluminum bezel insert with applied, C3 lume pip Hr and min hand diamond cut polished with C3 lume Sec hand diamond cut with C3 lume reverse lollipop Swiss mechanical automatic: ETA 2824-2 top grade 38 hour power reserve Novadiac anti-shock system Regulated accuracy +/- 4 sec/day

watches.name: Littlefield 39mm GMT Mechanical Watch
watches.description: DESCRIPTION When I think of Austin and the incredible history, weirdness, and character of the city, and see how it has evolved today into sky scrapers, corporate HQ, and more technology than ever seemed possible- it led me down the path of expanding and challenging DuFrane offerings as well. Still solely designed by me and based on all that is Austin, the Littlefield GMT is a stunning piece that’s assembled here in Austin like all DuFrane models. The Littlefield is named after Austin's first office building (built in 1912). This is really a tool watch for those who conduct business in multiple timezones, so it aligns to the use of such an historic Austin building. If you notice in the graphic image, one picture is the original Littlefield circa 1920's, with the other showing the modern day view of the building. Talk about traveling through time?! Only 100 available in the second batch with two dial colors, and featuring the three unique capabilities that make ownership spectacular ( D|Protect , D|Change and D|Adjust ), the Littlefield GMT will serve you dutifully with style. Choose either the celebratory America 250 Edition (white with red and blue accents), or the Texas Edition which uses the exact same colors as the Texas state flag. Both GMT versions include color-matched date wheel, open case back exposing the highly decorated Swiss Sellita SW330-2 automatic mechanical movement (Top grade), solid end-link 5 link bracelet, full grain curved-end leather straps, and packaged in the DuFrane leather delivery pouch. It is highly recommended to dap a tiny drop of Loctite Purple 222 to each screw pin when sizing the bracelet to prevent pins from unseating.I provide this service when the optional bracelet sizing is selected. SPECIFICATIONS Beautifully polished case sides and chamfers 39mm width 47mm lug to lug 12mm thin (with curved crystal) 20mm lug size 316L Marine Grade stainless steel case 120 click solid steel bi-directional bezel 5.5oz (155g) with included bracelet 6.5mm screw-down crown Sapphire domed crystal with 5 x anti-reflective coating Open case back with Sapphire crystal Swiss SuperLumiNova BGW9 lume Swiss Sellita SW330-2 automatic GMT (2 time zone tracking) top grade 56 hour power reserve 4Hz/28.8k BPH 25 jewels Regulated to +/-4 secs per day Includes solid end link bracelet and curved end full grain leather strap 100m water resistance

specsRaw.The celebratory edition: a white dial with red and blue accents, and a colour-matched date wheel.

watches.name: Bergstrom 42mm MkIV Manual Wind Pilot Watch
watches.description: DESCRIPTION This unique piece is named after Captain John August Bergstrom, who was stationed in the Philippines during WWII. Captain Bergstrom was the first Austinite casualty of the war when the base he was stationed succumbed to a surprise bombing. His legacy lives on in part by Austin's international airport bearing his name. Indulge in luxury with the sophisticated Bergstrom, version MkIV. Impeccably re-issued with new features, embodying elegance and style. Back after incredible demand, the iconic Horizon dial captures the imagination and adventurous spirit of those that took to the air in the early 20th century. Complimented with highly decorated Swiss manual wind movement, stunning dial finishes, mesh polished bracelet, and a limited-edition polished PVD case option, this timeless classic is available for the exclusivity of the few. Each piece will be numbered and only 300 units produced in this batch! ONLY 50 BLACK PVD VERSIONS. I launched the brand in 2016 with the original Bergstrom model, and over the years not only has this model been popular, but it has seen some small tweaks and enhancements over the years. The MkIV now includes a date function including an elegantly framed date window, while still maintaining the original hand-wound mechanical movement. Although the MkIV uses the Sellita SW261, instead of the ETA 6498, the art of daily interaction with superb hand winding is still a fundamental piece of ownership. IMPORTANT: Even though the Swiss made SW261-M does have some technologies built in to prevent overwinding, this is a manual wind movement, so make sure to stop winding once you feel some tension (I recommend only 15-20 winds per day). Once you begin to feel some resistance, stop winding. You will still need to screw the crown back in and that can add a couple rotations of the crown. FREE DOMESTIC SHIPPING SPECIFICATIONS 41.5 mm case width 11mm case thickness (12.6mm w/crystal) 22mm lug width 50mm lug to lug 65 grams (with leather strap) Screw down crown with double silicone gaskets Diamond cut Hr/Min hands with Swiss C3 lum Diamond Cut seconds hand in orange Marine grade 316L steel (polished silver or black PVD) 50 meters water resistance (164 feet) Screw down open sapphire crystal open case back Double domed sapphire crystal with 2X A/R coating Swiss Sellita mechanical SW261-M elaboré grade movement Date complication Manual wind 48 hours reserve time Highly decorated with Geneva stripes and blue screws Regulated accuracy +/- 4 secs/day

specsRaw.This is a manual wind movement: stop winding once you feel some tension. 15 to 20 winds a day is plenty, then screw the crown back in.

watches.name: Waterloo 39mm Mechanical Sporty Dress Watch
watches.description: DESCRIPTION The Waterloo is a versatile, classic watch that can complement a suit, but is practical and durable enough to accompany a weekend outing in jeans and a t-shirt. Simply put, this watch is an all around daily wearer. Each Waterloo delivers with both the bracelet and a curved end leather strap. The SW200-1 Swiss automatic movement from Sellita is durable, accurate and built to last for generations. Special thermal blued hands, genuine sapphire flat crystal with 6 layers of anti-reflective coating, highly polished stepped bezel, screw-down crown, and unique textured dial options (linen or hammered copper) all make for a truly special piece. The Waterloo includes a hand stitched Italian leather strap, with curved ends for a custom fit. These leather straps also include quick change spring bars. It is recommended to dap a tiny drop of Loctite Purple 222 or Blue 242 to each screw pin when sizing the bracelet to prevent pins from unseating. This is included with the optional Bracelet Sizing. SPECIFICATIONS Includes your choice of a custom curved end, full grain leather strap in brown, black, blue or red (all versions include the bracelet and a leather strap). Additionally your Waterloo will be delivered in a soft, yet protective, custom leather pouch. 39mm case width 47mm lug to lug 10.4mm thin 20mm strap width 100 meter water resistance 316L marine grade stainless steel case- finely polished and brushed finishes Available in Steel or Rose Gold PVD Triple gasket screw down crown system Genuine sapphire flat crystal with six layers of anti-reflective coating Thermal treated blued steel handset (not painted) Swiss C3 SuperLumiNova- handset tips and under 12, 3, 6, and 9 Milled markers on finely brushed chapter ring Option of soft linen texture or hammered dial finish Swiss Sellita SW200-1 elaboré grade movement Regulated to +/- 4 Seconds per Day 26 jewels 28.8k vibrations per hour/4 Hz Incabloc shock protection system Rhodium rotor 38 hour power reserve

watches.name: Mabry MkII 39mm Titanium Mechanical Field Watch
watches.description: DESCRIPTION The Mabry MkII Titanium Field Watch offers excellent durability and reliability with its titanium case/bracelet and Swiss made Sellita SW200-1 elaboré grade automatic mechanical movement. The SuperLumiNova BGW9 or C3 (dial selection dependent) ceramic, injected-mold indexes on the highly visible dial ensures easy readability in any light, making it ideal for outdoor activities and everyday wear. A full titanium grade 2 solid end link bracelet is included, as well as a nylon hook and loop strap. The watch only weighs 1.7oz total on the fabric strap! This flexible nylon strap has infinitely adjustable length and is secured with a micro hook and loop system. With the lightweight nature of titanium and the comfort of the fabric strap, the Mabry is an absolute dream to wear. Three dial color variations are offered to suite your style, and each piece will also be delivered in DuFrane's own full grain leather watch wallet. FREE DOMESTIC SHIPPING SPECIFICATIONS 1200 Vickers, DLC coated for scratch resistance 39mm width 47mm lug to lug 11.4mm thick 20mm lug size Titanium 2 case, with all-new Ti Compass bezel 1.8oz (52g) with fabric strap, 3.5oz on the bracelet (100g) 6.5mm screw down crown Sapphire crystal 5x anti-reflective coating Swiss SuperLumiNova BGW9 (Shadow Black and Service Blue) and C3 handset (Field White) Swiss Sellita SW200-1 Elaboré Grade movement (4Hz/28.8k bps) 35-42 hour power reserve Includes Ti SEL bracelet and infinitely adjustable fabric strap with micro hook closure 100m water resistance In-house regulated and timed to +/-4 secs per day
